name: hcportal_mergeHashers
description: Merge accounts, step 2 (E12.F6.S2): moves every run row and payment row (and memberships, chat, photos, receipts, down downs, songs, products, promotions, track imports, organiser links) from the merge account to the kept one; combines rows where both have one (runs by EventId+DisplayName, kennels, chat badges); recalculates run counts and kennel credit; disables the merge account as hcapp_gdprDelete does (Removed, every device signed out with a new secret, push tokens cleared). Nothing is deleted except exact duplicates in down downs, promotion and newsflash-read maps and friend links. Logged to LOG.GeneralLog. Requires HC.PlatformAdmin with CanEditKennel = 1.
sideEffects: UPDATE HC.EventMessage, EventMessageBadgeCounts, KennelPhotos, Receipt, DownDowns, DownDownHashers, Event (organiser), Song, SongSession, Product, Promotion, HasherPromotionMap, TrackImport, HasherOwnEvent, PortalNewsflash(Read), HasherFriendMap, PlatformAdmin
UPDATE HC.Hasher (keep fills blanks; merge Removed = 1)

codeSmells.issue: PackTrack points in Table Storage keep the old id
codeSmells.detail: Live positions are keyed by userId in Azure Table Storage. A run tracked by the merge account and not yet archived (the nightly job) stays under the old id; runs already archived travel with their HasherEventMap row.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
